perspectives.author: bharat_avlokan
perspectives.title: India has several national symbols that represent its rich culture, heritage, and values. The National Flag, known as the Tiranga, features three horizontal stripes of saffron, white, and green with a blue Ashoka Chakra in the center. The majestic Bengal Tiger is the national animal, symbolizing power and strength. The beautiful Peacock is the national bird, representing grace and elegance. India’s national flower is the Lotus, which stands for purity and wealth. The sweet Mango is the national fruit, and the massive Banyan Tree is the national tree. Together, these symbols unite the diverse people of India and fill them with pride and patriotism. 🇮🇳🇮🇳
